entries.final_answer: Orchestrator ruling D10, confirmed by the maintainer 2026-11-09: drain-aware wait. Keep the 5 s drain and the launcher contract unchanged (LAUNCHER.md:50-57; core launcher.py:83 STOP_TIMEOUT_S = 10.0; LauncherContractProcessTest NFR-003). entries.final_answer: Maintainer ruling D11 (2026-11-10): fix breaking_check. Keep x-provisional on WriteOperation. contracts/tools/breaking_check.py must not delete a stable property that only $refs a provisional schema when stripping provisional elements: it still compares that property's presence and requiredness, and skips only the provisional schema's own body and enum. Tool tests: stable property $ref'ing a provisional schema is kept (no false break); removing that property is still BREAKING; changing the provisional enum is not reported. AC 6 is then met literally (exit 0, no breaks). Recorded on #236; tooling change noted on #151.
